dict.string: STM Desktop Listener records your voice for private local or configured cloud transcription.
STM Desktop Listener captures selected screen regions for screenshots, OCR, color sampling, and pixel measurement.
STM Desktop Listener needs Accessibility permission to move the mouse for Mouse Jiggler and paste dictation results.
STM Desktop Listener asks Finder for selected files and the current folder when you copy paths, optimize images, or create a new file.
